{{Cycle|type|date}}
This template returns the value from certain cycles. === Parameters === ; ''unnamed parameter'' 1 : Cycle to select. Possible values: :* ZMission – [[Zaishen Mission]] cycle. :* ZBounty – [[Zaishen Bounty]] cycle. :* ZCombat – [[Zaishen Combat]] cycle. :* ZVanquish - [[Zaishen Vanquish]] cycle. :* Sandford – [[Nicholas Sandford]] cycle. :* Nicholas – [[Nicholas the Traveler]] cycle. :* Wanted – [[Wanted by the Shining Blade]] cycle. :* Vanguard – [[Lieutenant Langmar|Vanguard Quest]] cycle. :* VanguardS – [[Lieutenant Langmar|Vanguard Quest]] cycle, with its short title. :* ZQuests – combined [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]] cycle. Sets all four variables, ZMission, ZCombat, ZBounty, and ZVanquish. :* All – combines all options above, and sets variables for each. : Append a V to the normal cycle name, to only generate a variable instead of returning the value. ; ''unnamed parameter'' 2 : Optional. Absolute date or offset (for example +2 days). Defaults to the current time. [[Category:Data templates|Cycle]]
